![](tephritids.jpeg){width=60% fig-align="center" style="border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:1.5rem;"}

This database covers empirical research on Tephritid fruit flies (family **Tephritidae**), organised by genus and species. Each page shows active research themes, recent papers, and the researchers currently in this work. This page currently shows papers from 2026.

## About

Papers are sourced from Google Scholar, PubMed, and Web of Science. Only empirical
research papers are included — reviews are excluded unless otherwise noted. Coverage
is currently limited to 2026 publications and will be extended retrospectively.

> For questions or contributions contact: katie.millar@uea.ac.uk
